description: This is a Java test class for ImmutableExpressionResolver, testing its immutability, equality, and placeholder resolution functionalities, including handling of special characters, complex function chains, and error scenarios.

classes.name: ImmutableExpressionResolverTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableExpressionResolver, verifying immutability, equality, and placeholder resolution behaviors.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: setupClass
methods.description: Initializes the test environment with various placeholder resolvers and creates an instance of ImmutableExpressionResolver.

methods.name: testSuccessfulPlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Tests resolution of known placeholders within the input string.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolutionAllowingUnresolvedPlaceholders
methods.description: Verifies behavior when unresolved placeholders are encountered, expecting exceptions for unsupported placeholders.

methods.name: testUnsuccessfulPlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Checks that resolution of an unknown header placeholder returns an empty result.

methods.name: testSuccessfulFunctionBasedOnPlaceholderInput
methods.description: Tests resolution with function chaining, default values, and whitespace handling.

methods.name: testSpecialCharactersInStrings
methods.description: Ensures special characters within string defaults are correctly handled and preserved.

methods.name: rejectUnsupportedPlaceholdersWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Asserts exceptions for invalid placeholders with special characters.

methods.name: testUnsuccessfulFunctionBasedOnPlaceholderInput
methods.description: Checks that unresolved placeholders with functions return empty results.

methods.name: testSuccessfulSinglePlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Tests resolution of single placeholders into their corresponding values.

methods.name: testUnsuccessfulSinglePlaceholderResolution
methods.description: Verifies that unrecognized single placeholders return empty.

methods.name: testResolveBarelyTooComplexFunctionChainWorks
methods.description: Ensures that a chain of up to 10 functions resolves successfully.

methods.name: testResolveTooComplexFunctionChainResultsInException
methods.description: Verifies that exceeding the maximum allowed chain of 10 functions throws an exception.
